headline: Uzbekistan has begun negotiations with Australia on sending specialists to Australia's labour market
summary: Uzbekistan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Migration Agency held talks with Australia's Northern Territory on recruiting Uzbek workers. Oil and gas sector placement and candidate training were discussed.
why: Labour mobility agreements shape the supply of skilled workers to sectors such as oil and gas, which affects project staffing and remittance flows. Such deals are typically part of broader bilateral economic ties.
original_headline: O‘zbekiston Avstraliya mehnat bozoriga mutaxassislar yuborish bo‘yicha muzokaralar boshladi
